request.title: Lost your authenticator?
request.description: Use your current password and a verified email to set up a replacement authenticator.
email.hint: Enter the account's verified primary email, even if you want the link sent to its backup address.
destination.hint: The backup address must already be bound to this account and verified on this website. Delivery-provider verification alone does not qualify.
recognized.hint: Your current password and a previously verified email are required. Availability also depends on the account’s security checks.
sent.title: Check your email.
sent.description: If this account and destination are eligible, a recovery link will arrive. It stays valid for up to 30 minutes.
sent.hint: Have your replacement device and authenticator app ready before continuing. Your password stays the same.
link.title: Prepare your replacement.
link.description: Enter your current website password. After Continue, you have less than five minutes to set up the authenticator and save new recovery codes.
password.hint: Your password is checked once and stays unchanged. Do not enter an email-account password.
ready.device: My replacement device and authenticator app are ready
factor.title: Set up a replacement.
factor.description: Your existing authenticator stays active until you finish. Add the replacement as a separate entry.
totp.title: Add your replacement authenticator.
totp.description: Scan this QR code or enter the setup key in your replacement authenticator app, then verify its code.
qr.label: QR code for the replacement authenticator
qr.fallback: Use the setup key below if the QR code cannot be shown.
setup.hint: Use a time-based account. Keep this key private and keep your existing entry until recovery finishes.
codes.title: Save new recovery codes.
codes.description: Save all ten codes somewhere safe. They replace your old saved codes only when you finish.
codes.confirm: Enter one code from your saved copy
codes.hint: Save or download the whole set first. Read this code from the copy you saved.
ready.title: Ready to finish.
ready.description: Finish to activate the replacement and new recovery codes. Your password stays unchanged, and previous sessions are signed out.
done.title: Your authenticator is replaced.
done.description: Use the replacement entry and new saved recovery codes. Previous sessions, the old authenticator, and old recovery codes no longer work.
done.hint: Your website password stays the same. Wait for the next fresh code from the replacement authenticator before logging in.
restart.hint: The setup was interrupted. Restart this step within the existing time limit; the deadline does not change.
cancel.title: Cancel this recovery?
cancel.description: Cancelling this credential recovery pauses new recovery attempts for 24 hours, including other methods. Your current password and authenticator stay active; ordinary login is still available.
cancelled.title: Recovery cancelled.
cancelled.description: This request is closed. New recovery attempts pause for 24 hours; your current credentials remain active.
expired.title: This recovery expired.
expired.description: The short replacement session or email link can no longer be used. Request a new link when your device and app are ready.
refused.title: This recovery cannot be used here.
refused.description: The link, account, or security checks could not approve this recovery. If you have an unused saved recovery code, you can use that recovery method.
saved.link: Recover with a saved recovery code
saved.hint: Use this if you saved an unused recovery code, including when you do not know your password.
known.link: Know your password but lost your authenticator?
known.hint: Use your current password and a previously verified email to replace it.
switch.title: Switch recovery method?
switch.description: Close this recovery before starting another method. Your current credentials remain active.
switch.unknown: The cancellation could not be confirmed. Check the state before switching; a missing or expired session is not a closure receipt.
switch.pending: Open the current recovery email link first, then cancel the request before choosing another method.
error.proof: That password or code was not accepted. Check it and try again.
error.code: Enter the six-digit code from the requested authenticator. Spaces are accepted when pasting.
error.rate: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
error.unknown: We could not confirm the result. Check the recovery state before repeating a change.
backup.title: Backup email verification
backup.description: Verify the backup address already bound to this account so it can be used for eligible recovery. This does not change the address.
backup.unavailable: No backup address is available for verification.
backup.sent: If this request is eligible, a link will arrive at the existing backup address. Open it to finish website verification.
backup.error: Verification could not be confirmed. Check the status before requesting another link.
backup.link.title: Verify your backup email.
backup.link.description: Continue to confirm this address for your account. Your password and authenticator remain unchanged.
backup.done.title: Backup email verified.
backup.done.description: This bound address is verified on the website. It can be used for eligible recovery; account recovery rules still apply.
backup.expired.title: This verification link is unavailable.
backup.expired.description: The link expired or is no longer valid. From Settings, request a fresh link for the existing backup address.
backup.confirm.unknown: The result could not be confirmed. Check this link's bounded confirmation receipt before repeating anything else.
cancel.pause: Cancelling this credential recovery pauses new recovery attempts for 24 hours, including other methods. Your current password and authenticator stay active; ordinary login is still available.
deadline.unknown: The time limit ended before we could confirm the result. Your website password is unchanged. Return to login to check access; this screen cannot confirm which authenticator is active.
